quote: A 2 (alignment) × 2 (congruency) × 2 (task) repeated measures analysis of variance (ANOVA) revealed a main effect of congruency, F (1, 21) = 41.84, p < .001, η p 2 = .67
reason: For Experiment 1a (p. 4 / p. 216), the main effect of congruency on performance (d') across both tasks in the 2 (alignment) × 2 (congruency) × 2 (task) repeated-measures ANOVA has partial eta-squared = .67 (F(1, 21) = 41.84, p < .001). The shipped value of 0.56 comes from the subsequent separate single-task ANOVAs in Experiment 1a (where both the face task, F(1, 21) = 26.35, and the line-pattern task, F(1, 21) = 26.30, had ηp² = .56) or from Experiment 2's 3-way ANOVA (F(1, 21) = 26.51, ηp² = .56).
